Which preparation the criterion means. As implemented, a take held back most by its own preparation (lines, breakdown, rehearsal, the way of playing rehearsed in) is read as prepared, and knowing the genre is read as it is known today, since familiarity carries from piece to piece and isn’t prepared for one.
